scope: One-Atom mathematical Taylor diagnostic only; no optimizer, learning, public backend implementation or speed measurement
notes: Gaussian sigma and Chebyshev radius use the same numeric values solely to probe identical geometric boundaries; shapes/initial RMS are not matched.
ChebyshevSpec M changes the mathematical density, not merely the accuracy of approximating a fixed Gaussian; CPU reference only, no new CUDA mode support.
Tiny-step and near-zero-derivative relative errors are roundoff-sensitive; no speed or quality inference.
